decisions.reason: After two years without market visibility, this non-strategic handle line would be judged below aspiration and its resources redeployed to stronger core ranges or new development.
As an overlapping core handle family that no longer appears in the market-facing offer, it is likely to be pruned once learning has resolved demand uncertainty unfavorably.
A single design variant close to the established range gets little continued slack after several years, and its prolonged absence signals performance below internal and peer benchmarks.
Like other narrow design introductions, sustained non-observation indicates it did not earn a place in the portfolio and would be discontinued in favor of better-performing variants.
Even though it initially supported portfolio breadth, two years without website presence suggest unfavorable results relative to aspirations and subsequent range rationalization.

Despite its strategic fit with digital access, the original flagship system's disappearance for two years suggests it underperformed or was superseded, so management would shift resources to newer integrated platforms.
